title: Brazilian Chicken Skewers with Italian Twist
description: A fusion of Italian flavors with the vibrant taste of Brazilian chicken skewers. This dish is perfect for a quick and easy dinner.
instructions: 2. In a large bowl, whisk together olive oil, garlic, lime juice, and Italian seasoning.
3. Add the chicken pieces to the bowl and toss to coat.
4. Season with salt and pepper to taste.
5. Thread the chicken onto skewers, leaving a small space between each piece.
6. Grill the skewers for 8-10 minutes, or until the chicken is cooked through.
7. Let the skewers rest for a few minutes before serving.
